name: Total + running left sum
whenToUse: The standard answer: two passes, no extra array. The right sum comes from total − left − nums[i].

card.signals: "sum of all the numbers strictly to the left" and "strictly to the right" of an index: sums of a prefix and of a suffix.
card.pattern: a prefix sum kept in one variable. The first pass finds total. In the second pass left is the sum of nums[0..i − 1], and right is found from total. O(n) time.
card.coreIdea: The array splits into three parts: left side, nums[i], right side. So right = total − left − nums[i]. After checking i, nums[i] joins the left side: left += nums[i].
card.variant: exclusive prefix sum. left does not include nums[i] ("strictly to the left"), so it starts at 0 and nums[i] is added only after the check. The first version of left = 0 also covers index 0 with no special case.

invariant: At index i: left = nums[0] + … + nums[i − 1], and right = nums[i + 1] + … + nums[n − 1].
